content.text: When working in enterprise security, you often encounter situations where you need to assign numerous roles to servers. Don't you find it daunting to figure out how to manage and track such vast permissions? In Episode 3, we took a close look at how to efficiently manage numerous permissions across a large number of servers and multi-cloud environments using QueryPie's system access control solution, 'QueryPie SAC (System Access Controller)'.
How to efficiently manage permissions across a large number of servers and multi-cloud environments
Asset automation management through cloud synchronization and auto-scaling
How to configure roles using IaC
Maximize your security management efficiency with 'QueryPie SAC'. Check out the detailed usage in [Ch. QueryPie: 3-Step Side Kick]!
